entries.zh: 阳间；人世，活人所居的世界（与阴间相对）；活着的时候，生时
entries.en: the world of the living, this world (as opposed to the netherworld); to live, while alive

entries.zh: 守；看守、守持（此处指寡妇守节）
entries.en: to keep, guard; (of a widow) to keep chastity

entries.notes: R 栏后段 'gno ccara' 未明，释义依 L（viuda que no se casa）与 H（孀）两栏；M 栏空缺

entries.en: chastity, moral integrity (of a widow who does not remarry)
entries.notes: 字头作「卽」，据词头与 R 对音 chièr 判为「節（节）」之用；M 栏空缺

entries.zh: 孤寡；无子的寡妇，孤苦无依的寡妇

entries.en: to remain a widow, to keep widowhood (not remarry)
to keep chastity; (of a widow) never to remarry
entries.notes: 字头作「守卽」，「卽」按词义与对音当为「節（节）」

entries.zh: 贞守；守贞，寡妇守节不再嫁

entries.en: chaste woman; faithful widow (who does not remarry)
to keep widowhood; to remain a widow

entries.notes: 字头作「貞卽」，「卽」按词义与对音当为「節（节）」

entries.zh: 鳏夫；丧妻不再娶的男子
entries.en: widower (a man who does not remarry)

entries.zh: 义夫；妻亡守义不再娶的男子
entries.en: faithful widower; a husband who keeps fidelity to his dead wife and does not remarry
